# SMS-Plugins

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before working. It is the authoritative
repository instruction file. Load only task-relevant references from its index.
Prefer cheaper capable sub-agents when delegation saves total cost; keep affected
documentation accurate and indexed with each change.

Local commits are allowed. Never push branches or tags, use APIs to bypass this
rule, publish releases, or delegate to a workflow that automatically pushes.
If your environment requires automatic remote writes, hand off for local work.
